_doc: Team-wide ENFORCED rules (gate #43 rule-pack). ADD a rule = append an object — no code. Grown automatically by scripts/quality-loop.mjs (a real caught defect becomes an enforced rule so it can never silently recur). Types: forbid-text · forbid-section-pattern · require-section · require-pattern · forbid-css-pattern · pin-design-system. severity: block | warn (default block). Entries without a `type` are skipped (so this _doc is inert).

message: z-index >= 9999 — escalation war; use the design-system layer scale, don't out-bid. (Promoted warn→block 2026-07-22: cravinbyandy shipped FOUR stylesheets all at 9999 — base.css, about-cafe, catering-services, menu-cards — the classic 'modal opens behind the other modal' latent bug. A warn was ignored for 9 days.)
non-descriptive link text 'click here' — use a meaningful label (a11y 2.4.4 + SEO)
viewport blocks pinch-zoom (WCAG 1.4.4) — remove user-scalable=no / maximum-scale=1
<html> missing a lang attribute — screen readers + SEO require it (warn: a partial build may not have theme.liquid yet)
no skip-to-content link — keyboard users must tab through the whole nav on every page
theme uses no responsive/lazy images anywhere — add srcset + loading=lazy for LCP
deprecated HTML tag — use CSS / semantic markup
document.write blocks parsing + breaks async — use DOM APIs

_doc: ── Platform-authoring rules (Training 2.0, 2026-07-23) ──────────────────────────────────────  These enforce shopify-theme-authoring-standard.md. Every pattern below was CALIBRATED against a real 69-section client theme before being added: each one produces ZERO hits on files this build did not add or modify. That matters because until 2026-07-23 this gate had no base-diff scoping and would have judged ~100 vendored Dawn files by our rules — a false BLOCK is as bad as a false pass, and it is why this pack sat at 8 rules for a month. Recalibrate with the probe in the standard doc before changing any pattern.

message: STD-TOKEN-03 — inline SVG paints a literal colour, so it ignores the merchant's colour scheme. Use currentColor and let the scheme drive it (snippets/enquiry-icon.liquid is the in-repo reference: 0 hardcoded). Gate #3 editability explicitly allowlists fill/stroke OUT of its colour grep, so nothing else catches this.

STD-TOKEN-04 — a literal font stack in section CSS pins typography outside the theme's global type settings, so changing the font in admin does nothing here. Bind to var(--font-body-family) / var(--font-heading-family). `inherit`/`initial`/`unset` are allowed (form-control resets).

STD-TOKEN-02 — a colour setting piped into an inline style= bypasses the colour-scheme system entirely. Remove the colour setting; wrap the section in color-{{ section.settings.color_scheme }} and use rgb(var(--color-foreground)). Carries no literal, so both gates that scan inline styles miss it by construction.

STD-IMG-03/STD-IMG-01 — the image filename is COMPUTED (usually from forloop.index) and read out of assets/, so reordering blocks silently swaps photos and the merchant cannot change any of them. The image must come from the block's own image_picker, with placeholder_svg_tag as the empty state — never a bundled JPG.

STD-NAV-02 — active-nav state derived from request.path breaks on handles, query strings and localized paths. Dawn compares link.current / link.child_active and sets aria-current="page". (warn, not block: request.path has legitimate uses in canonical/breadcrumb logic — check the call site.)

STD-CMT-02 — Figma node ids, CHANGES.md cross-references and client-decision dates are design provenance, not code explanation. They belong in docs/design/. Shipped CSS should explain a browser quirk or an ordering constraint, nothing else.

STD-CMT-03 — a developer note in any language shipped to production. Found live: `/* apne icon size ke hisaab se adjust karo */` inside an inline <style> in a client section. Gate #36 only knows English TODO/FIXME markers, so nothing else catches this.

STD-CMT-04 — a raw <style> block with no Liquid interpolation is static CSS hiding in a section; it belongs in assets/section-<name>.css. NOTE: {% style %} is CORRECT and required for settings-bound CSS (Dawn uses it in 20+ sections) — this rule only catches the un-interpolated kind.

STD-TOKEN-01 — a literal rgb()/rgba() channel triple is a hardcoded colour the scheme system cannot reach. Use rgb(var(--color-foreground)) / rgba(var(--color-foreground), 0.08). (warn: shadows and overlays are the common legitimate-looking case and need a designer's call, not a blind rewrite.)
